long_biography.plain_text:
Marine conservation defines the Athanasios C. Laskaridis Charitable Foundation, which Thanasis Laskaridis and Evi Lazou-Laskaridis co-founded. It organises year-round clean-ups of remote shores and works with Greek universities to turn collected material into research data on Mediterranean marine waste.

The foundation has widened that approach from removing litter to preventing it. Its Cyclone Project traces waste reaching the sea from inland waterways and includes local residents in clean-up and education. The Saronicos Project combines seabed mapping, pollution studies and community participation to guide restoration of a heavily pressured gulf. These programmes make scientific evidence, not one-off giving, central to the foundation's marine work.

uncertainties.detail: The immutable record uses Thanasis, Capital Link and the foundation use the formal Athanasios C. Laskaridis, and English-language shipping publications commonly use Thanassis. The exact birth date and company chain establish these as forms of the same name; the display name is preserved while the well-supported middle initial is proposed.

Panos, formally Panagiotis, is Thanasis's older brother and was his long-time partner in Lavinia. Current official and specialist material separates Panos's Lavinia and Laskaridis Shipping branch from the Alimia and Laskaridis Maritime platform controlled by Thanasis's family. Panos's offices and foundation work are not attributed to Thanasis.

Konstantinos Laskaridis already operated fishing and refrigerated vessels before both sons joined. The brothers then moved into reefer chartering and built a much larger diversified shipping group. This supports Inherited and expanded rather than treating Thanasis as either a passive heir or an independent-start founder.

TradeWinds identifies the platform as Thanassis-led and his family as its controller, while current day-to-day management also involves the next generation. The dossier therefore uses Operator for his material historic and current strategic role without claiming that he personally manages every daily function.

Public-company and corporate materials document material family interests in hotels and a smaller continuing Aegean Airlines interest, but shipping remains the clearer current principal sector through the controlled Alimia platform. No current percentage or transient market value is used in either biography.

The owner input stores a malformed Wikipedia URL containing two spaces. The canonical exact-person page is https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thanasis_Laskaridis, but the dossier does not propose a duplicate social type because Wikipedia already exists in the immutable baseline; the bad URL should be handled by a social-correction workflow rather than an additive import.

No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was verified. Name-only and family-member accounts were excluded; only the official Alimia company website is proposed.
All current and historical personal vessel facts, fleet counts, orderbooks, monetary estimates, politics, allegations, legal matters, controversy and sensitive private-family detail are excluded.
